examples: credential exposure; unauthorized access; cross-tenant leakage; material privacy breach
immediate_internal_action: Contain affected authority/access where authorized; preserve logs/configuration/evidence; open incident record
evidence_preservation: Preserve relevant immutable logs, access decisions, configuration/version and affected-scope evidence without copying secrets
closure_requirements: Human-reviewed containment; root cause; corrective action; effectiveness evidence; unresolved legal/contract duties recorded

examples: provider outage; unexpected model behavior; material model/version change; unapproved fallback; provider data-use concern
immediate_internal_action: Fail closed or disable affected provider path where authorized; preserve requested/resolved provider-model identity and execution evidence
evidence_preservation: Preserve provider/model/version, acquisition mode, execution attempt, telemetry and supplier-change evidence
closure_requirements: Affected execution path reviewed; supplier/model reassessed; fallback/retry authority validated; corrective action verified

examples: persistent outage; failed recovery; lost delegated work; checkpoint corruption; repeated runtime failure
immediate_internal_action: Stabilize service; stop unsafe replay; preserve recovery/checkpoint/work ownership state; invoke approved recovery process
evidence_preservation: Preserve failure timeline, checkpoints, lease/outcome state, recovery attempts and runtime evidence
closure_requirements: Service/recovery state verified; silent-work-loss assessment completed; corrective action/effectiveness recorded
review_trigger: Material availability/recovery failure or unexplained delegated-work loss

examples: unauthorized spend; reservation bypass; unexplained provider charges; settlement mismatch; runaway retry/cost loop
immediate_internal_action: Pause cost-bearing path where authorized; preserve reservation, attempt, pricing and settlement evidence; reconcile exposure
evidence_preservation: Preserve budget authority, reservation, attempt identity, pricing/rate-card version, usage and settlement evidence
closure_requirements: Spend reconciled; authority gap corrected; residual financial risk reviewed; recurrence control verified
review_trigger: Unauthorized/unexpected material spend or budget-control failure

examples: poisoned memory; incorrect provenance; unauthorized ingestion; sensitive retrieval; retention/deletion failure
immediate_internal_action: Stop affected ingestion/retrieval where authorized; quarantine suspect derived data; preserve source/provenance lineage
evidence_preservation: Preserve source identifiers, lineage, classification, retrieval/derivation records and correction history without duplicating sensitive payloads
closure_requirements: Affected data lineage reviewed; correction/containment verified; retention/access implications resolved; recurrence test recorded
review_trigger: First material memory/RAG corpus or any material data-integrity/privacy event

examples: unauthorized consequential action; stale/revoked grant used; C3/C4 bypass; agent authority drift; unsafe external action
immediate_internal_action: Stop or revoke affected execution authority where authorized; preserve authorization/grant/execution evidence; escalate immediately
evidence_preservation: Preserve capability/grant/decision/execution identity, actor lineage, dissent, recovery and external-effect evidence
closure_requirements: Human management review; authority path corrected; affected risks reassessed; independent verification before reactivation
review_trigger: Any suspected unauthorized consequential action or authority-control bypass

examples: material supplier outage; security incident; terms/subprocessor/residency change; package compromise; loss of service
immediate_internal_action: Assess dependency and blast radius; invoke fallback/exit plan if justified; preserve supplier notice and dependency evidence
evidence_preservation: Preserve supplier notice/source, affected systems, versions/dependencies, contingency actions and communications
closure_requirements: Supplier reassessment completed; substitution/exit implications recorded; affected controls/risks updated
review_trigger: Material supplier incident/change or evidence of supply-chain compromise

examples: evidence tampering; false certification/compliance/deployment claim; suppressed dissent/failure; unsupported critical control claim
immediate_internal_action: Stop unsupported claim; preserve original/corrected evidence; constrain affected approval path where authorized; escalate immediately
evidence_preservation: Preserve original evidence, correction lineage, actor/approval history and affected claims
closure_requirements: Independent/human review; claim corrected; root cause and corrective action verified; affected decisions re-evaluated
review_trigger: Any suspected evidence-integrity breach or materially unsupported assurance claim
